description.value:
Your eidolon unfurls its radiant wings in a grand display. Each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] must attempt a @Check[will|against:class|options:area-effect] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round, and dazzled for 1 minute. If the creature was unholy, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 1 round, dazzled for 1 minute, and stunned 1. If the creature was unholy, the creature is stunned 2.
